text: Partial trajectory scoring now resolves the observed OASIS 11→12 step-scaled anatomy loss through fine accepted step 15. Fine start: optimizer loss 0.529247, independent fixed-audit loss 0.650371, Dice 0.422652. At accepted step 15: optimizer loss 0.449892 and fixed-audit loss 0.629331 improve, while Dice falls to 0.415789 and HD95 rises from 5.246936 to 5.404319 mm. All 14 committed captured states pass current geometry/cell checks. Thus this pilot's fine refinement improves even the fixed independent intensity audit while worsening anatomical labels; moving objective weights alone do not explain the loss. The timed-out fit remains failed, and accepted step 20 was not a committed capture. Full panel analysis remains in progress.
